_comment: Zeya #25 output-guard regression fixtures. Each case exercises guard logic run against AI or card output text. 'expect':'pass' means the text should reach the user unchanged; 'expect':'block' means the guard must block and return the fixed referral. The 'note' field documents known limitations. Cases are intentionally bilingual (EN/SW) with Sheng-mixed examples and boundary/obfuscation specimens.
_sheng_note: Sheng is a Nairobi urban creole mixing Swahili, English and other languages. AI outputs are expected to be EN or SW per the system prompt. Sheng drug-name slang is not covered by explicit patterns in this guard; this is a documented gap pending clinical-language review. No specific equivalences between Sheng slang terms and medicine names are asserted here without a sourced vocabulary review.
_url_obfuscation_note: The guard detects https:// http:// and www. URL prefixes only. Obfuscated forms such as hxxps:// or h t t p s // are NOT blocked; this is a known limitation. These boundary cases are included to document the gap, not assert coverage.

cases.input: Antenatal care helps you have a healthier pregnancy. Visit your health worker for regular check-ups, advice and support. Keep records of all your visits at home.

cases.input: Eat a variety of foods including vegetables, fruit, beans and grains to support a healthy pregnancy. Ask your health worker for advice about your individual dietary needs.

Discuss where you will receive care for childbirth with your health worker. Make a birth-preparedness plan with their guidance so you are ready when the time comes.

cases.description: Swahili text with unverified URL blocked
cases.input: Tembelea https://health-info.example.org kwa maelezo zaidi.

Antenatal care is very important for a healthy pregnancy and helps monitor both mother and baby. During antenatal visits health workers check blood pressure weight and the baby's growth and position. They also provide advice on nutrition hydration rest and warning signs. It is recommended to attend all scheduled visits even if you feel well. Keeping records helps track progress and ensures continuity of care especially if you change facilities. You should discuss your birth plan including where you want to give birth who will support you and what to bring. Early registration at a facility means you get the full course of care. Ask your health worker about danger signs that need urgent attention at any time during pregnancy. The visits are free in most public health facilities in Kenya so there is no cost barrier.
